name: Audience Discovery and Values
description: Begin by understanding the person’s goals, beliefs, constraints, and moral priorities, then align explanations to those values and knowledge gaps.
subsumes: Elicit Values First; Elicit Beliefs First; Clarify Goals Early; Elicit Prior Beliefs; Elicit Goals First; Precision Empathy; Calibrate to Prior Knowledge; Calibrate Baseline Knowledge; Values Framing; Shared Goals Framing

name: Common Ground Foundations
description: Start from shared definitions and uncontested facts to prevent talking past each other and to build a cooperative base for harder topics.
subsumes: Calibrate With Shared Facts; Define Terms Clearly; Build Shared Ground; Calibrate Common Ground

name: Layered Evidence Transparency
description: Present a clear core claim supported by layered, credible sources and consensus, with explicit uncertainty ranges and visuals to build trust.
subsumes: Credible Evidence Layering; Layered Evidence Build; Credible Evidence Ladder; Use Layered Evidence; Evidence Layering; Present Layered Evidence; Use Transparent Sourcing; Source Transparency; Present Consensus Clearly; Calibrated Consensus; Quantify Uncertainty; Uncertainty With Ranges; Uncertainty With Boundaries; Transparent Uncertainty; Visual Evidence Scaffolding

name: Mechanisms and Analogies
description: Explain how and why effects occur using simple causal models and accurate analogies so intuition and data reinforce each other.
subsumes: Use Causal Mechanisms; Analogies and Mechanisms; Concrete Analogies; Counter-Mechanism Focus

name: Stories and Personalization
description: Pair concise statistics with relatable stories and local, concrete examples, tailoring impacts to the person’s community and daily life.
subsumes: Use Concrete Narratives; Narratives with Numbers; Narratives Plus Numbers; Narratives with Mechanisms; Localize and Personalize; Local and Personal Relevance; Local and Lived Examples; Local and Personal Impact; Concrete, Localized Examples; Personal Relevance Framing

name: Prebunking and Debunking
description: Proactively inoculate against common myths and rhetorical tricks, diagnose misconceptions early, and correct them with concise, evidence-backed refutations.
subsumes: Prebunk and Inoculate; Prebunking and Inoculation; Prebunking & Inoculation; Counter-Argument Prebunking; Prebunking and Debunking; Prebunk and Reframe; Interactive Misconception Check

name: Steelman Counterarguments
description: Accurately present the strongest opposing views and acknowledge real costs, then respond with fair comparisons and evidence.
subsumes: Counter-Argument Steelmanning; Counter-Argument Steelman; Steelman and Acknowledge Costs; Steelman Their View

name: Decision Framing and Trade-offs
description: Translate evidence into concrete choices by quantifying costs and benefits, using counterfactuals and principled bridges from values to policy.
subsumes: Decision-Relevant Framing; Transparent Trade-offs; Trade-off Transparency; Quantify Trade-offs; Compare Counterfactuals; Counterfactual Scenarios; Decision-Focused Reframing; Principle-to-Policy Bridge

name: Interactive Iterative Dialogue
description: Use question-driven, stepwise engagement to calibrate understanding, co-analyze scenarios, summarize progress, and build agreement incrementally.
subsumes: Ask-Tell-Ask Loop; Interactive Socratic Probing; Interactive Scenario Testing; Interactive Evidence Dosing; Interactive Calibration; Interactive Fact-Checking; Iterative Summaries; Progressive Goalposts; Summarize and Commit; Confidence Calibration; Incremental Commitments

name: Identity, Autonomy, Messengers
description: Reduce reactance by affirming autonomy, respecting identities, and using trusted, in-group messengers who lower social costs of agreement.
subsumes: Affirm Autonomy; Acknowledge Identity Concerns; Use Trusted Messengers; Local and Identity Messengers

name: Action Design and Follow-Through
description: Convert agreement into behavior with low-friction choices, small commitments, clear next steps, and accountable follow-ups including testable predictions.
subsumes: Choice Architecture & Defaults; Choice Architecture; Interactive Choice Architecture; Commitment and Plan; Commitment and Recap; Actionable Next Steps; Agency and Next Steps; Commitment to Follow-Up; Offer Testable Predictions; Testable Predictions
